items.title: Gemini eyewear starts at $395
items.takeaway: If hands-free directions would help your crews, try one pair in the field before buying for the team.

items.title: OpenAI outlines what comes after custom GPTs
items.takeaway: List the GPTs your team relies on and test a replacement with the same tasks before switching.

items.title: ChatGPT opens business listings to owners
items.takeaway: Check what ChatGPT tells customers about your hours and services, then claim the listing so you can update it.

items.title: Claude brings shared workspaces into the meeting
items.takeaway: Team and Enterprise users can test the Google Meet beta on an internal call and compare its output with their usual notes.

items.title: Railway customers face $740,000 in unauthorized AI usage
items.takeaway: If you hosted AI keys on Railway, rotate them and check your provider’s usage and billing.

items.title: Intuit takes hands-on AI training to 30 U.S. cities
items.takeaway: If a stop is nearby, bring one task you already do every week and use the free session to try it.
